_about: Hand-labeled (resume, JD) pairs with a recruiter-style fit bucket. Used to test that the matching agent ranks pairs in roughly the right order and emits scores within the band for each bucket. Scale this up by ingesting HuggingFace 'cnamuangtoun/resume-job-description-fit' (≈4k pairs, labels: Good Fit / Potential Fit / No Fit).
